messages:
maria: nightly-evals-bot just flagged a large drop on the 'summarize-news' promptset after we rolled fp8-dyn2 for rw-7b-v3. overall ROUGE fell from 0.82 -> 0.61 :eyes:
nightly-evals-bot: AUTO-EVAL 1952100000 | model=rw-7b-v3 | profile=fp8-dyn2 | promptset=summarize-news | metric=rouge-l | baseline=0.82 | current=0.61 | delta=-0.21 | artifact=https://artifacts.redwood/internal/nightly/1952100000/report.html
maria: attaching quick diff and a snippet from the eval runner logs:
```
--- baseline (fp16) ---
rouge-l: 0.820
--- current (fp8-dyn2) ---
rouge-l: 0.610
avg_token_logit_norm: 1.23 -> 0.47
per_layer_scale_clip_counts: [0,0,3,12,45,120,230]
```
raj: how many calib samples did we use for fp8-dyn2? iirc the change switched to a 512-sample streaming subset to speed rollout. could be under-calibrated for long-context summarization.
oliver: correct — we cut calib from 2048->512 and added per-channel clamping. suspect top layers saturating at the clamp threshold, causing very low logits and softmax collapse on long prompts.
maria: can someone run a quick per-layer scale histogram and compare float32 vs fp8? if top layers show mass at clamp_max that's our smoking gun.
raj: running now. command i'll run:
```
eval-cli compare --model rw-7b-v3 --profiles fp16,fp8-dyn2 --promptset summarize-news --out /tmp/eval-1952 --hist per_layer_scale
```
ci-bot: job started: nightly-compare-1952 | logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/nightly-compare-1952/logs
raj: early peek: top 3 layers have >90% of scales at 127 (clamp_max). float32 run shows a smooth tail.
maria: that explains the avg_token_logit_norm drop. can we repro by forcing no-clamp on fp8 profile? try fp8-dyn2-noclip with same calib samples.
oliver: i can spin a dev cluster and run the same promptset with 2048 calib samples + per-tensor quant instead of per-channel. will take ~30m.
raj: meanwhile, rollback option: patch routing to keep that traffic on fp16 for rw-7b-v3 in hosted for the summarization route. quick fix until we validate. :thumbsup:
maria: agreed, put a canary rule to steer summarize-news route back to fp16 and start an extended eval with increased calib size and remove the clamp. also add a small eval for long context (2k tokens) — this failure seems sequence-length dependent.
ci-bot: canary rule created: route=summarize-news -> model=rw-7b-v3@fp16 | change_id=chg-1952100011 | rollout=100%
raj: hypothesis list for post-mortem:
- clamp_max too low for fp8-dyn2 per-channel scales on recent weights
- reduced calib sample count introduced sample skew away from news-like long contexts
- per-channel vs per-tensor mismatch changes dynamic range
- kernel-level FP8 accumulation subtlety causing underflow at top-layers

maria: next steps: oliver run noclip+2048 (dev), raj run per-tensor+512 to isolate per-channel effect, i'll collect prompt-level diffs and start a short postmortem doc. ping me if you need GPU time. :coffee:
oliver: started dev run (job=dev-fp8-noclip-1952). will paste logs when done. :spiral_calendar:
raj: copied artifacts to /artifacts/1952100000/ for triage. tagging eng-runtime for kernel-look if dev runs still fail. :sos:
